Omnia 970, Classic Solid Brass Knob Only

Part of Omnia's Traditions Collection, the 970 Knob features a simple elegance that makes it alluring. Made out of solid brass, this door knob will look great in any home.

Specifications for Omnia 970 Classic Knob:

  • Knob Diameter: 2"
  • Knob Projection: 2-1/2"
  • Oil Rubbed Bronze finish

*Sold Individually.
